name: Golden Visa (Autorização de Residência para Investimento / ARI)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires subscribing at least €500,000 to a CMVM-regulated investment/venture-capital fund with a maturity of at least 5 years from the date of investment, at least 60% of which must be invested in Portuguese-seated commercial companies. This fund route does NOT qualify for the low-density discount that applies to other Golden Visa categories.
requirements.fix_path: Secure and commit the required investment.

value.note: €400,000 in eligible low-density interior territories, a 20% discount

requirements.blocker_text: This requires at least €500,000 (or €400,000 in a designated low-density interior territory) invested in scientific or technological research through a public or private institution within the national science system.
requirements.fix_path: Secure and commit the required investment.

value.note: €200,000 in eligible low-density interior territories, a 20% discount

requirements.blocker_text: This requires at least €250,000 (or €200,000 in a designated low-density interior territory) in support of artistic production or maintenance/recovery of national cultural heritage.
requirements.fix_path: Secure and commit the required investment.

requirement_groups.name: Company creation or capital reinforcement plus job creation

requirements.blocker_text: This requires at least €500,000 (or €400,000 in a designated low-density interior territory) to create a new company, or reinforce the share capital of an existing one, creating or maintaining at least 5 permanent jobs (8 in low-density areas) for at least 3 years.
requirements.fix_path: Secure and commit the required investment and job creation plan.

value.note: 10 permanent jobs created (8 in eligible low-density interior territories), no minimum capital amount attached

requirements.blocker_text: This requires creating at least 10 permanent jobs (8 in a designated low-density interior territory) — no minimum capital investment is attached to this category specifically.
requirements.fix_path: Establish the business and create the required permanent jobs.

evidence_required.document: Proof of investment (fund subscription certificate, capital transfer records, or job-creation payroll evidence depending on category)

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: minimum 7 days in Portugal in year 1, minimum 14 days in each subsequent 2-year period — one of the lowest physical presence requirements of any route in this entire dataset

sources.title: AIMA — Autorização de Residência para Investimento (ARI), Art. 90.º-A and consolidated Lei n.º 23/2007 Art. 3(1)(d)

notes: MAJOR STRUCTURAL CORRECTION vs the route's own reputation: the real-estate acquisition and capital-transfer investment categories were ABOLISHED for new applicants on 7 October 2023 (Lei n.º 56/2023, Art. 42) — this is the single most consequential 'the internet still describes an old version of this route' case in the entire dataset. Many people (and some outdated tier-3 guides) still think of Portugal's Golden Visa as fundamentally a real-estate route; it no longer is, for anyone applying now. Existing real-estate-route holders from before the reform can still renew under the old terms — not encoded here since this file represents the current NEW-applicant path only, same pattern as uk_start_up's closed-status handling. Fee structure is genuinely steep and recently increased: reception/analysis €842.80, grant €8,418.90, renewal €4,210.30 (effective 1 March 2026) — by far the highest fees of any route across all four countries in this dataset, consistent with this being an investment-migration product rather than a standard visa. The 20% low-density discount applies to research/cultural/company/jobs categories but explicitly NOT to the investment-fund route, which stays flat at €500,000 regardless of location — modeled correctly per-group here rather than as a single blanket discount. Physical presence requirement (7 days year 1, 14 days per 2-year cycle thereafter) is dramatically lower than any work/family/study route in this dataset — the core structural trade-off of investment migration, worth surfacing prominently in any comparison view. Realistic processing time (12-36 months per tier-3 estimates, given AIMA's backlog) is far longer than the 90-day statutory target — flagged honestly rather than only stating the statutory figure.
